title: Refugee Haven
location: Salvari Camp — a hidden cave settlement of bioluminescent crystal
summary: The last of a genocided species shelters in a cave that sings. Earn their alliance, learn the cure, and meet the steward who will teach you to fight a war you didn't start.

objectives.text: Enter the camp. Let them see your hands before your weapons.
Hear K'thara out. Thirty survivors from thirty billion is not a number you argue with.
The Nordic Steward at the upgrade station offers to teach. Accept the lesson, or take only the gear.
They don't trust you. Prove the camp is safe in your hands before they open anything.

args.text: Stand the perimeter watch. Let an Overlord probe come and go without firing first.

objectives.text: K'thara offers to join you — and offers the cure synthesis. Decide what the alliance is built on.
Refuge, for now. The war is still out there, but you have a door that closes and people behind it.

_hooks: Wraps act2-desert's L11 Salvari Camp + the nordic-mentor branch (Nordic Steward at the upgrade station) into the alliance quest. K'thara recruited here (ally:true) is the canon Salvari leader / Beta-romance option; first_contact tree authored in chat_trees/kthara.json. salvari.cure_known is the cure thread the Carrier arc (act2_the_quiet_channel) reads. Registers the camp as a re-enterable hub (like Club 1127). A low-karma player must earn trust first (o2_wary) — a non-blocking detour.
_voice: K'thara is grief carried with dignity, never self-pity. The Steward is dry, practical, second-species outsider wisdom ("You fight like a man who only just learned he's allowed to.").
